title: Battle of Williamsport
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Williamsport", at revision 1370276911, opens: "The Battle of Williamsport, also known as the Battle of Hagerstown or Falling Waters, took place from July 6 to July 16, 1863, in Washington County, Maryland, as part of the Gettysburg campaign of the American Civil War. It is not to be confused with the fighting at Hoke's Run which was also known as the Battle of Falling Waters." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q841297, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
